title: Everything i used for a Space MMO on S&Box
author: ShadyShaid
selftext:
I connected my Claude (20€/month) sub with the S&Box MCP and Blender MCP and started developing the space MMO Eve Online but in fun and with action. And SUNO AI for music background / trailer. And elevenlabs for the ai companiens voices.

Techstack:  
\- Claude Opus 5.5  
\- S&Box MCP  
\- Blender MCP  
\- SUNO AI  
\- Elevenlabs 

  
How to do it:  
\- Set a "project" in Claude.   
\- Click on the Robot button of the s&box Editor to get the adress for the MCP Server.   
\- You need to tell the AI early on to do a MMO like game on S&Box, it will need a dedicated server running on your maschine to be able to do that.   
\- Blender MCP is a bit harder to install. Just follow those steps: [https://www.blender.org/lab/mcp-server/](https://www.blender.org/lab/mcp-server/)  
\- Tell claude to test and enjoy

Costs:  
\- 20€ Claude sub  
\- Others: free trial, were enough.

I was suprised how well Opus worked with those MCPs, i needed 2 weeks of Claude tokens to make a releaseable game on S&Box.



Play here: [https://sbox.game/kaidlabs/spacemmo\_test](https://sbox.game/kaidlabs/spacemmo_test)

Trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-o7Z\_OzyZ\_Y](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-o7Z_OzyZ_Y)
